request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: acme-001. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: Open remediation tickets for every device that is currently failing the screen lock check.","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"action","restated_question":"Identify all devices in acme-001 whose latest snapshot shows a failing screen lock compliance check, and propose one remediation ticket per device for human approval.","assumptions":["'Currently failing' means the screen lock check is failing on the device's latest telemetry snapshot.","'Screen lock check' maps to the compliance check named for screen lock / auto-lock in the telemetry.","Tickets are only proposed and require human approval before they are created.","One ticket per affected device."],"steps":[{"tool":"query_devices","purpose":"List every device whose latest snapshot has the screen lock check failing, with owner details."},{"tool":"open_remediation_ticket","purpose":"Propose a remediation ticket for each device returned, citing the failing screen lock check, for admin approval."}],"may_propose_actions":true,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
